```{r}
library(truncnorm)
```

```{r}
td1<- round(rtruncnorm(n=250,a=0,b=100,mean=50.72, sd=31.46))
td2<- round(rtruncnorm(n=250,a=0,b=100,mean=50.72, sd=31.46))
td2 <- td2+5
```

```{r}
t.test(td1,td2)
```

Pausing to consider why a headline is true or false can help reduce the sharing of false news - 501 participants

```{r}
shareData <- read.csv('share_data_osf.csv')
```

```{r}
shareData$shareDisc = shareData$TRUE. - shareData$FALSE.
g1 <- shareData %>% filter(Explain == 0)
g2 <- shareData %>% filter(Explain == 1)
g1 <- as.double(g1$shareDisc)
g2 <- as.double(g2$shareDisc)
cohensD(g1,g2)
```
